title: Length of her stays and the north: Ireland, Dundee
summary: She stayed about sixty days in one place, enjoyed Dublin, a steak, and Scotland's hospitality.

blocks.x: So you were there quite a long time in '48.
Yeah. I was longer than that in '53. I stayed quite a bit both times I was over there. I didn't come right back. I stayed as long as I could, you know, on my work thing
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

Yeah. Well, no. Sixty days in one place. But the second time I was there when I toured the British Isles, well I could stay over there longer because I was crossing borders all the time. Wales, Scotland, Ireland -- as long as, you know, I got out of town at the end of sixty days.
I enjoyed being outside of London because it was actually warmer up in Scotland, in Wales and Ireland.
When I got to Ireland -- when I got to Dublin -- this is March, right?
It was bleak in England. When I got to Dublin, the sun was shining. And I saw all this green.
And I was in a hotel, and I ordered this food. Boy, I had a steak that you wouldn't believe, with mashed potatoes. I hadn't seen a meal like this in about three months. And, of course, you know,
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

food was plentiful, and I could eat. And when I went -- oh, but Dundee and Aberdeen, you know you stay in digs -- people's houses. And even in the theater, in Dundee especially, the conductor of the orchestra -- his wife used to bring tea over, you know. And when I left Dundee -- I guessed they knew where I was -- I was going to go to Cardiff -- I had shopping bags full of food. I wondered what I was going to do with all this food! But I began to realize what I was going to do with it. Like I was on the train for so long. But the people were warm. It was not like being in the heart of London where it's -- you know, it's boom, boom, boom, boom, boom. But I could relax. I had a good time. I really had a good time. At one time, I came back and I was thinking about sending my daughter to Scotland to go to school, especially to Dundee because -- I met
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
some very wonderful people there. They were very friendly.
But the only time I've been back is on those couple of engagements with the World's Greatest Jazz Band. And we would just be in and out.
But a lot of people that saw me in '53, you know, back then, they came to the concert.
That's another project that needs to be organized.
